# Generated Codex Plugin

This compatibility projection was generated for `golden-plugin`.

## Projected Skills

- `with-support`
- `without-support`
- `review-deep-thing`
- `review-agent`

## Compatibility Notes

- Skill "without-support" sets user-invocable=false in Claude metadata. Codex compatibility keeps it as an explicitly invokable skill.
- Agent "review-agent" is emitted as explicit skill "review-agent" because Codex plugin packaging is skill-based.

interface:

  short_description: Review changes
policy:

# Review Agent Agent

This skill is generated from a Claude subagent definition.
Invoke it explicitly with `$golden-plugin:review-agent`. Codex will not auto-invoke it.

# Review Agent

Invoke explicit skill `$golden-plugin:review-agent` with description `Inspect the diff`.
